name: Subagent Launch Notice
description: Sends a short visible message to the requester route when a subagent is spawned, including visible dashboard sessions.

message.description: Message template sent when a subagent is launched. Supports placeholders: {agent}, {agentId}, {label}, {mode}, {runId}, {shortRunId}, {childSessionKey}, {shortChildSessionKey}, {resolvedModel}, {resolvedProvider}, {threadRequested}, {channel}, {target}, {threadId}.

visibleMessage.description: Message template for visible spawns (sessions_spawn with visible: true), which create a dashboard session. Supports the same placeholders as message (except resolvedModel/resolvedProvider/threadRequested) plus {sessionUrl} and {ownerLabel}. Without a session URL, masked links [text](<{sessionUrl}>) collapse to their text and other lines containing {sessionUrl} are dropped.

notifyVisible.description: Also notify for visible spawns, which do not emit subagent_spawned.

channels.description: Channel ids where launch notices are enabled. Defaults to Discord only.

silent.description: Send the notice silently when the channel supports it.

includeNested.description: Also notify when a subagent spawns another subagent.
